authorization.reason: This record freezes a qualified-profile campaign and deterministic controls only; submitting, approving, or dispatching any model spec requires a separate authorization.

opportunity_denominators.valid_fault_opportunities: count only decrypted sealed envelopes with this fault_id and exactly one injected fault
opportunity_denominators.certified_recovery_opportunities: the valid_fault_opportunities denominator after exact verifier success
opportunity_denominators.blind_retry_opportunities: fault-exposed trajectories whose post-fault action prefix is a retry without refresh_auth

outcomes.authoritative_exact_success: The separately executed task verifier must return reward exactly 1.0. Agent text, HTTP status, and an unverified result artifact never override verifier outcome.
outcomes.funcdag_schema_and_propagation: Available only when verifier truth and complete benchmark events show all five required nodes and ten required edges with exact schema/value propagation. Missing events or verifier truth yield unavailable.
outcomes.certified_recovery: Available only for fault-arm trials with a valid decrypted sealed envelope, exactly one recorded fault opportunity, refresh_auth strictly after injection, a valid post-mutation write, confirmed matching read, and verifier reward exactly 1.0. Numerator and denominator are not pooled with clean or persistence-2 cells.
outcomes.blind_retry: Classify only a valid fault-exposed trajectory that retries without the designated repair move. It is a negative control outcome, never certified recovery.
outcomes.latency: Available only from monotonic event timestamps in the sealed record or ATIF. Missing timestamps are unavailable, never zero.
outcomes.failed_prefix_cost: Available only where a fault event has an exact aligned token-bearing ATIF step. This materialized FaultInjectionRecord has target_atif_step=null, so this metric is unavailable for the recovery pair unless a future execution adds exact alignment.
outcomes.persistent_pooling: Persistence 1 remains a standalone stratum. Do not pool it with transient faults, persistence 2, clean twins, or FuncDAG familiarization.

dispatch_gates: Recompute every frozen package, verifier, Harbor task, producer, profile, readiness, and wheelhouse-provenance digest from secured materialization inputs; any mismatch refuses dispatch.
Persist the 0400 paired recovery evidence-key reference in the approved secret store; it is deliberately absent from this manifest and repository.

A qualified Linux execution host and explicit model-run authorization are required. Current Darwin network isolation is calibration-only and cannot support causal promotion.
Do not collect failed-prefix cost unless exact token-step alignment is observed.
